fields.name: Speed
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x20051E0 (applies a LightDesc to a light entity) copies LightDesc+0x64 (SE: LightDesc::MovementSpeed) here and adds/removes the component according to LightDesc+0x6E (IsMoving); bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 uses it as frequency in three sines (x1, x1.1, x0.9).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x20051E0 (applies a LightDesc to a light entity) copies LightDesc+0x68 (SE: LightDesc::MovementAmount) here; bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 multiplies the sines by it to get the positional offset stored in the light at +0xE0/+0xE4/.. and added to the transform.

fields.name: Time
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 adds the frame delta to it every update and uses it as the sine argument; creator bg3.exe+0x20069F0 is the twin of the flicker creator (which zeroes it) but its listing was not read line by line. Probe: 218.5 in all instances.
